cr_data.provenance: (The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY); Oliver B. Jennings, New York, NY, 1958; Estate of Oliver B. Jennings, 1968; Private collection, New York, NY, purchase, 1968; Sotheby Parke Bernet Inc., New York, NY, sale no. 4628M, lot no. 80, 29 May 1981 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Double entries Downtown Gallery Archive. Not recorded Whitney Archive. Downtown Gallery Archive dates 1915 and 1917. Abiquiú Notebooks dates 1917. Dated 1917 on basis of Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence. Abiquiú Notebooks indicates 25 in 1958 exhibition. Downtown Gallery Archive indicates 34 in 1958 exhibition. See cat. no. 176. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Nude No. IV

description: In this loosely rendered, minimalist composition, a nude woman with a dark braid sits facing the viewer. The woman is seated on an unseen surface against a loosely painted blue background.
title: Nude No. IV
